body.message:
Okay, I understand your point.

I am aware that you have already reserved the apartment for someone else. However, the issue is exactly that the apartment was reserved, because I had already mentioned this when I moved in.

I clearly told your team that I might need to extend my stay for 5 more days, and I was told that it would be okay and that I could arrange the extension closer to the end of my stay.

This information was given to me by one of your own staff members.

I understand the situation you are facing now, and I understand that the apartment has been reserved. But the main problem is that it was reserved despite the information I was given earlier.

Could you please explain how you will be able to help me with this situation?
